howto.what: Claude 会帮你把业务模型和传输/持久化用的 DTO 分开，并用版本化契约集中管理映射，避免模型在不同层之间泄露。
howto.when: 当你需要设计或重构 API、处理数据模型边界、或进行模式演进时，Claude 会按步骤收集证据并生成契约版本策略、映射器位置和命名规范。

howto.what_en: Claude separates domain models from transport/persistence DTOs and centralizes mappings with versioned contracts to prevent model leakage across layers.
howto.when_en: When you need to design or refactor APIs, handle data model boundaries, or evolve schemas, Claude collects evidence and produces contract version policy, mapper placement, and naming conventions.

say_en.text: Create a v1 DTO mapping for this user model.
say_en.note: Claude generates mapper and version policy.

say_en.text: Check for model leakage across layers in the codebase.
say_en.note: Claude scans boundaries and reports issues.
